name: qkd_static_kv_landing_lane_h3

pin_regs.reason: Every pin is a flop in RTL (landing PC input registers / out_* registers; hop registers; rowctl request and response registers); a synthesis pin stage would add an edge.

slot_change_request: KVCTRL 1815: child of qkd_static_kv_landing_seg_h (hierarchical landing seg, 151.2 x 1,512 parent slot unchanged). Lane = one landing PC: E face = its return-slot word (actual_*/expected_*), W face = its 256-b rsp_data lane, N face = row/relay seam + arm/epoch/layer/cfg/reset/clock; placed 4 x (lanes 2/3 MX so N faces the centre).
structural_change: KVCTRL 1815 (lead Q-KV 2026-10-16): structural variant of qkd_static_kv_landing_seg. The flat ls5 tile (151.2 x 1,512 um) is 9 % utilised and its ONE ck root measured 722..753 ps TT insertion over 1,512 um (9,492 sinks): even a CLOSED flat view fails native launch (<= 220 ps). qkd_static_kv_landing_seg_h = wires-only parent of hardened children with short local roots: 4 x qkd_static_kv_landing_lane (one master: landing PC + SRAM + that PC's 256-b response data pipe, at the PC pitch; lanes 2/3 mirrored), qkd_static_kv_landing_row (rowctl DATA 0 + near-branch hops 1/2) at the centre, 2 x qkd_static_kv_landing_relay (far-branch 0/3 hops, half way). Same registers, same edges: cycle-identical to the flat seg (latency 8); cycles_added 0. Bench = the flat seg bench with seg_h as DUT (run_landing_seg_h.sh) + the flat bench logs compared. h2: lane h1 gate measured TT insertion 168.5..231.9 (spread 63.4) with logic in W/E pin bands + an N cluster and an empty S half (103.68 tall, 36% util): compact to 140.4 x 88.56 with the SRAM low (>= 20 um from every core edge), so the clock tree spans less. h3: h2 gate TT insertion 183.2..248.9 (boundary mean 203.8, spread 65.7) with ck at the NW corner: ck pin centred on the N face (x 69-71.4) so the tree reaches the W rsp_data and E actual_* pin-flop bands symmetrically.
